holds.question: Is case/session + configured injectate + physiological episode the right series identity; should a series acquired during an evolving response be flagged or split?
Confirm per fault which displays still name the chamber (level, motion, respiratory phase) and which withhold both (overdamped, underdamped, mislabel, scale).
Section 3 teaches end-expiratory c-wave base; section 8's RAP input is 'mean at end expiration'. Which does the module teach, and should section 8 change?
Must the mPAP feeding PVR be end-expiratory?
Is the one-cycle mean centred on an end-expiratory cursor the wedge value to teach, and is +/-0.12 of the breath an acceptable model window?
Unchanged: the 7.4 mmHg per 10 cm figure and its source.
Should the Fick teaching explain the direction a central venous saturation can mislead? No registered source; nothing written.
Which PLR endpoint should the module provide: a thermodilution series during the leg raise, a sourced flow surrogate, or the labelled model-only view?
Should HD-08/section 9 show authored prior erratic curves as authored evidence, from which source or specification?
Fluid in HD-03/HD-04: hard interrupt, permitted-but-unfavourable (current), or different coefficients? The model shows a small flow rise with fluid in both.
Should HD-05 offer a vasopressor or explain its absence?
Should HD-07 be re-parameterised to be hypotensive rather than the brief changed?
Per-case action menus hint at the diagnosis; a common menu would add inert options.
Per-line level and zero, or keep the stated shared-transducer limitation?
